messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH - gpu-node-17 | reason=kernel_panic; symptom=kubelet NotReady; affected=host/gpu-node-17
pagerduty: Page sent to rotation: eng-oncall (ack required)
Alex (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. pinging infra and checking cluster status.
Maya (sre): Got the same. kubelet shows NotReady, node hasn't heartbeated for ~45s. Serial console shows kernel oops.
Sam (infra): I can't ssh to 10.12.34.17 — connection timed out. IP ARP not responding from top-of-rack.
Leila (customer-fx): Any customer-facing impact? Any tenants on that host?
Alex (oncall): Checking pod placement now. Looks like 6 GPU pods were on the host — 3 critical jobs (training) and 3 batch. Frontend routing unaffected.
Maya (sre): Metrics: GPU-util dropped to 0 at 14:03 UTC. Node lost kubelet at 14:03:12.
Sam (infra): I'm starting remote serial capture and will pull kernel logs if possible. Asking hardware to check IPMI reachability.
Alex (oncall): For mitigation: plan is cordon + drain the node (force evict GPU pods to spare pool), then mark host for RMA if hardware unresponsive. Any objections?
Maya (sre): +1. I'll run graceful drain with 10m grace where possible, force for batch jobs.
Alex (oncall): Running commands:
```
# cordon node
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
# drain best-effort, ignore daemons
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=600
```
Maya (sre): `drain` started. Some pods are stuck terminating — GPU driver process not responding on node, so eviction taking longer.
Sam (infra): Serial snapshot attached. Kernel trace: `NMI: GPU timeout` then `kernel panic - BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer deref`. Suspect driver/kernel combo panic.
Alex (oncall): Documenting customer impact: 3 training jobs failed and restarted on spare capacity, 1 job lost progress (no checkpoints). Reached out to affected teams: ml-research, onboarding-ml.
Leila (customer-fx): Notifying customers impacted by training job failure now. Quick message drafted: "Heads up — short GPU host outage impacted some training runs, jobs are being rescheduled. We'll follow up with root cause and any recovery options." Want to send?
Alex (oncall): Send now. Include estimated ETA for full recovery (TBD after RMA).
pagerduty: Alert escalated to level-2 after 5m unacknowledged by oncall secondary.
Maya (sre): Node remains unreachable via kubelet; `kubectl get nodes -o wide` shows: 
```
NAME           STATUS     ROLES   AGE   VERSION
gpu-node-17    NotReady   gpu     34d   v1.26.4
```
Alex (oncall): I'm verifying spare-pool capacity. Canary autoscaler had 2 spare GPU nodes; scheduling is moving critical pods there. Some batch tasks queued.
Sam (infra): IPMI is reachable but SOL session shows console spam and then hard reset at 14:05:21. Hardware team advised to RMA board if node fails POST after powercycle.
Maya (sre): For immediate mitigation, I've updated rollout policy for model-serving to reduce load on GPU-backed endpoints (lower concurrency) and set fallback to CPU-quantized variant for latency-sensitive routes.
Leila (customer-fx): Noted. Customers informed. Logging: ticket created 23456 for affected customers.
Alex (oncall): Recording actions for incident log: cordon+drain initiated, pods rescheduled to spare-pool, hardware notified, RMA pending, customers notified. Adding owner: Alex.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3551234567 | priority=high | owner=Alex (oncall) | status=mitigating
Maya (sre): I'm going to tail kube-controller-manager and scheduler logs for any eviction issues. If evictions fail after 15m, we'll force delete stuck pods.
Sam (infra): I'll attempt a remote soft-reboot via IPMI and capture dmesg after reboot. If it fails POST, open RMA with vendor.
Alex (oncall): Update: 4 of 6 GPU pods successfully rescheduled, 2 stuck — I'll force delete if they don't detach in 5m.
Maya (sre): Force-deleted the two stuck pods, they recreated on spare nodes. Application-level recovery looks ok for most; one training job needs checkpoint restore.
Leila (customer-fx): Customer updates: Sent short note to affected customers, put incident notice in status page.
pagerduty: Alert acknowledged by Alex (oncall).
Sam (infra): Reboot attempt succeeded; node POSTed but kernel panic reproduced during driver init. Vendor RMA recommended. Preparing RMA ticket with serial and core dump.
Alex (oncall): Given hardware-level kernel panic on driver init, we're marking node out-of-service and scheduling RMA. Moving to monitoring mode; if no further impact, we'll hand off to next oncall for continuity.
Maya (sre): Post-incident items: 1) add more aggressive preemptive checkpointing for long training jobs, 2) expand spare-pool by 1 GPU node, 3) add kernel+driver pairing tests to CI for infra images.
Leila (customer-fx): I'll coordinate the follow-up customer comms once we have RMA timeline.
Alex (oncall): Handoff: I'm handing off incident to Maya for overnight watch and follow-up action items. Next steps: RMA ticket, postmortem with timelines and impact, and patch scheduling.
Maya (sre): Handoff acked. I'll own the postmortem and coordinate with infra on RMA.
incident-bot: Incident assigned to Maya (sre). Status=watching.
Alex (oncall): Thx team. Ending active mitigation. Please add any logs/screenshots to INC-2026-3551234567. :thumbsup:
